name: async-wait-guard
description: Avoid wasteful model wakeups while long-running asynchronous tools are still working.

interface.shortDescription: Avoid wasteful polling of long-running tools
interface.longDescription: Apply a narrow long-wait policy after a process has already returned a running handle: delay empty polls, keep interactive input immediate, preserve an outer yield margin for nested waits, and avoid unsupported Token-saving claims.
defaultPrompt: Plan an efficient wait for this running asynchronous tool.
Explain whether this polling loop wakes the model unnecessarily.
